discards.claim: POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails on its own timing conjunct as well. It requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence 'at or before' the arrived event, and the earliest qualifying in-geofence fix on the trace is 23:42:21, which post-dates the trip record's 23:42:10 marker; the trace jumps from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21, so the 186-second gap swallows the moment of entry and no fix sits at the marker at all. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the contested SGD 6.00 Changi Terminal 1 no-show fee cannot be decided on this record and is going to a human reviewer. The fee is placed on hold (fare_breakdown shows payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) — it is neither collected nor refunded while review is pending. An escalation is not a win for either side; it is a refusal to guess.

The fact that decides this case is whether the driver completed the mandatory 480-second in-geofence dwell for an AIRPORT pickup, measured under POL-NS-01(c) from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the arrived tap. The only artifacts that carry that fact are both impaired for policy purposes:
- EV-GPS-00210 (driver device, weight 0.25; CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD). It is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) on a 228-second device clock skew, and under POL-NS-08(b) on a 186-second sampling gap sitting exactly across the entry moment, only 9 fixes in the trip, fewer than six across the waiting window, and a missing rider_track.
- EV-TRIP-00210 (platform telemetry, weight 0.40; CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT), impaired under POL-NS-08(a) because it disagrees with the trace on the termination time by more than 90 seconds.

On the trace read at face value the first qualifying fix is 23:42:21 and the cancellation 23:49:05, a 404-second dwell 76 seconds short of 480. Corrected by the 228-second skew the same fix maps to 23:38:33 server time, a 632-second dwell comfortably over. The 186-second gap conceals the one moment that would choose between the two, so neither reading is established on admissible evidence.

Turning to the claims that survived to this stage. The rider's two shortfall arguments — the 255-second longest qualifying run, and the trip record's own wait_time_min of 6.9 (414 seconds) against 480 — are accepted as pointing the same way, but each rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)/(b); such a claim cannot alone carry a finding against the party it disfavours, and the two figures do not agree with each other or with the skew-corrected trace. The driver's points are answered too: the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination code and the absence of a boarding event are not contested, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard genuinely does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d of 2 against the threshold of 4, and a rate of 0.013 against 0.08), so SGD 4.80 of compensation would have followed had the fee been chargeable — but chargeability is exactly what is undecided. The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04 either, because its limb (c) is undecidable on a missing rider_track and an undecidable limb is neutral rather than satisfied.

Because the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d), that clause caps the ruling at PARTIAL_REFUND and sends the case to POL-NS-09. POL-NS-09(b) is also engaged: two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves the conflict — clock-skew matching is unsafe under POL-NS-05 read with POL-NS-08(a), and the traffic_advisory that would let POL-NS-06(i) sum separate in-geofence intervals is MISSING at weight 0.0. Confidence is capped by POL-GEN-02(2) at the weight of the carrier of the deciding fact, 0.25, below the 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) is engaged as well. No clause produces a referral here: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, and the POL-NS-07 packet instruction does not fire because the anti-farming check does not trip.

The open question the reviewer must settle: resolve the 228-second clock skew and reconstruct the geofence-entry moment inside the 186-second gap to fix the true in-geofence dwell. If it reaches 480 seconds, the SGD 6.00 fee stands and SGD 4.80 compensation is payable to the driver under POL-NS-07; if it falls short, the fee is refunded in full to the rider under POL-NS-06 with no compensation payable.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
